WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
with_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    transreg,
    ordertypedist,
    avg_short_interest,
    avg_option_volume,
    AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS baseline_short_interest
  FROM transaction_averages
)
SELECT
  transreg AS transaction_reference,
  ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
  avg_short_interest,
  avg_option_volume,
  avg_short_interest / baseline_short_interest AS short_interest_ratio
FROM with_baseline
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
